run_atari_spin_training: run SpIN training on Atari video data with configurable game, iterations, and learning rate
train_spectral_network: train a spectral inference network on Atari game frames using SlownessOperator and RMSprop optimizer
create_spectral_network: create a SpectralNetwork instance with SlownessOperator, a conv network builder, and input data
build_conv_network: build a convolutional neural network with configurable strides, paddings, and weight variables
create_plotting_hooks: create matplotlib plotting hooks to visualize eigenfeatures and loss during SpIN training
